tx:
▸ Making a cup of tea
Making a cup of tea requires level 20 Cooking and gives the player 52 experience. The following furniture must be present in the player-owned house: a stove, a larder, a shelf, and optionally a sink.
• Remove a kettle, a teapot and one or more cups from the shelf.
• Remove one unit of tea leaves from the larder.
• Use the kettle on the sink (or any other water source, even outside of a player-owned house) to fill it with water.
• Use the full kettle of water on the range to bring it to a boil.
• Use the tea leaves on the teapot to turn it into a teapot with leaves.
• Use the hot kettle on the teapot with leaves to create four servings of tea. This is the only step that grants Cooking experience.
• Use the pot of tea on a cup to pour a cup of tea.

tx:
• One redberry pie is used to bribe Thurgo into helping the player, either to create a blurite sword during The Knight's Sword or to repair a dwarven battleaxe during The Giant Dwarf. Only one pie needs to be used for both quests.
• Thurgo can create an Imcando pickaxe if given a redberry pie, along with four Imcando pickaxe fragments, a gilded dragon pickaxe, and 1,000,000 coins.
• A redberry pie and 1,000,000 coins must be given to Thurgo while having a dragon mattock, slice of imcando metal, shard of imcando metal, lump of imcando metal, and chunk of imcando metal in the backpack in order for him to teach the player how to smith the imcando mattock. 
• Thurgo can also create an Imcando hatchet if given a redberry pie, along with four Imcando hatchet fragments a dragon hatchet, and 1,000,000 coins.
• A redberry pie can be given to Ramarno during or after Defender of Varrock for 1,000 Smithing experience. This completes the master quest cape achievement Blinded by Ramarno's Teaching. 
• Ramarno requires one when upgrading a pickaxe of earth and song to a pickaxe of life and death.
• Kili lists redberry pie as an equipment upgrade task requirement to upgrade Deathwarden robes to tier 80.
